text: ROSHN Group describes itself as Saudi Arabia's leading multi-asset class real estate developer and a Public Investment Fund (PIF) company, in a press release naming it Title Partner of ROSHN Group LIV Golf Riyadh 2026.

source.name: ROSHN Group press release
source.quote: ROSHN Group, Saudi Arabia's leading multi-asset class real estate developer and a Public Investment Fund (PIF) company, has been announced as Title Partner of ROSHN Group LIV Golf Riyadh 2026
